working_definition: Mi4 is a medulla intrinsic narrow-field columnar (unicolumnar) neuron of the Drosophila optic lobe. It arborises in medulla layers M1-M5, M8 and M9, with both fine and bleb-type processes across most layers. It receives input from lamina monopolar neuron L5 and photoreceptor R8 and is GABAergic, placing it in the OFF-pathway circuitry of the medulla.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Medulla intrinsic narrow field neuron with both fine and bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M1, M2, M3 and M8, but with only fine arborizations in medulla layers M4 and M5, and only bleb-type arborizations in medulla layer M9 (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It receives input from the lamina monopolar neuron L5 and photoreceptor R8 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is a GABAergic neuron (Takemura et al., 2017). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: The cluster label 'Mi4' directly names the canonical medulla intrinsic neuron Mi4, a well-characterised Drosophila optic lobe cell type. FBbt:00003779 ('medulla intrinsic neuron Mi4') matches on every defining feature: narrow-field columnar medulla intrinsic neuron, arborisations in layers M1-M5/M8/M9, L5 and R8 input, and GABAergic neurotransmitter. The term is not obsolete. The cluster label is the standard abbreviated anatomical name; there is no ambiguity between the atlas cluster and this FBbt term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the medullary intrinsic neuron Mi4 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: This term describes the immature/developmental form of Mi4, whereas the Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas profiles adult neurons. The cluster represents the mature adult cell type.

recommendation: Accept FBbt:00003779 (medulla intrinsic neuron Mi4) as an exact match. The cluster label is the standard abbreviated name for this well-curated FBbt term; all anatomical, connectivity, and neurotransmitter features align precisely.
